top_stories.title: ED raids Pinarayi Vijayan's residences in CMRL-Exalogic case - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: **The Enforcement Directorate (ED)** conducted raids on the residences of former Kerala Chief Minister Pinarayi Vijayan and his daughter, T. Veena, in Kannur and Thiruvananthapuram, alleging that her defunct firm received substantial monthly retainers from **Cochin Minerals and Rutile Limited (CMRL)** between 2017 and 2021 without rendering any tangible service. The raids triggered protests across the state, with CPI(M) activists allegedly vandalizing vehicles carrying ED officials.  The ED is verifying bank transactions of Ms. Veena while stating no incriminating documents were found at Mr. Vijayan's residence.

top_stories.title: ED freezes ₹18.36 crore and 242 bank accounts Exalogic-CMRL payoff case - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: The **ED** froze ₹18.36 crore in 242 accounts following raids conducted on Wednesday as part of an alleged pay-off case involving **T. Veena**, daughter of Kerala's Leader of the Opposition, **Pinarayi Vijayan**. The searches targeted premises linked to Ms. Veena and the management of the **CMRL** (Kannur Metro Rail Limited) in Kerala and Bengaluru.  The ED is investigating proceeds of crime generated by the CMRL, led by S.N. Sasidharan Kartha, along with Ms. Veena. The investigation stems from previous findings by the Income Tax department that revealed fake expenses amounting to ₹130 crore.

top_stories.title: BIS organises awareness session for footwear manufacturers - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: **The Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS)** organized an awareness session for footwear manufacturers in Ambur, Tirupattur. The event aimed to educate MSMEs and stakeholders on Indian Standards, Quality Control Orders, conformity assessment, and testing requirements.  Senior BIS officials from Chennai participated alongside representatives from Vellore and Ranipet leather industry clusters.

top_stories.title: Fruit vendor found dead in Tirupattur - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: **L. Santhammal**, a 68-year-old fruit vendor from Tirupattur, was found murdered inside a government egg procurement godown near the office of the Deputy Superintendent of Police on Wednesday.  Initial investigations suggest she had been waiting in the godown before visiting her daughters' home due to heavy rain. **Superintendent of Police (SP) Akshay Anil Wakhare** inspected the scene and fingerprint experts and sniffer dogs are assisting with the investigation. A case has been registered, and special teams have been formed to apprehend suspects.

top_stories.title: Twisha Sharma death case: Madhya Pradesh HC quashes anticipatory bail of retired judge Giribala Singh - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: The **Madhya Pradesh High Court** has quashed the anticipatory bail granted to retired Bhopal district judge Giribala Singh in the Twisha Sharma dowry harassment and death case. The court, citing inconsistencies in the evidence and lack of remorse from Ms. Singh, ruled that the trial court did not adequately consider the prosecution's claims.  The **CBI**, which took over the investigation, is expected to arrest Ms. Singh soon for custodial interrogation.

top_stories.title: Watch: We analysed thousands of Trump’s posts - here’s what we found
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Donald Trump**'s social media activity on his platform **Truth Social** has increased in 2026, with the BBC analyzing thousands of posts to understand patterns. The analysis revealed busy days and hours for posting content, as well as the types of topics discussed.

top_stories.title: Catholic priest said ‘we are but men’ when challenged over sex with spiritual directee, court hears | Texas | The Guardian
top_stories.rephrased_article: A Texas court is hearing testimony in the trial of **Anthony Odiong**, a former Catholic priest accused of sexually assaulting multiple women he met while providing spiritual guidance.  **Odiong**, 57, has pleaded not guilty to five charges of first-degree and two counts of second-degree sexual assault. The son of one of his alleged victims testified that he witnessed **Odiong** having sex with his mother at a party in 2011.  The son's testimony was corroborated by the testimony of another woman, who claimed she endured an abusive marriage and was coerced into engaging in sexual acts with her husband by **Odiong**. The trial is expected to continue through Monday.

top_stories.title: No specific port project identified, says Fiji’s Foreign Minister, day after Quad Foreign Ministers pledge assistance - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Fiji's** Foreign Minister Sakiasi Ditoka stated that no specific port project has been agreed upon, despite a declaration by the **Quad** foreign ministers at their meeting in New Delhi.  The **MCC** Compact of the United States is being considered for funding feasibility studies on infrastructure development in Fiji. The announcement was made following discussions between the **Quad** countries and the Fijian government, which has been strengthening ties with China, particularly regarding infrastructure projects.

top_stories.title: Can the US and India repair ties over trade and China? | US-Israel war on Iran | Al Jazeera
top_stories.rephrased_article: **US Secretary of State Marco Rubio** visited India to repair strained ties following trade disputes and energy politics.  The trip comes amid a global energy crisis that has forced **India** to reconsider its oil and gas purchases, with **Washington** seeking to increase energy sales to the country. Both sides aim for a broader trade deal, but **India**'s reliance on Russian crude and China's growing influence complicate the situation.

top_stories.title: Jill Biden worried husband Joe was ‘having a stroke’ during 2024 US debate | Government News | Al Jazeera
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Jill Biden** expressed concern about her husband, former President Joe Biden's performance during the 2024 presidential debate. She stated that she was frightened by his behavior and believed he was having a stroke.  The incident marked a turning point for Biden's re-election campaign, leading to speculation about his health and mental acuity. Following the debate, Biden suspended his campaign and Trump continued to question his fitness for office.
